placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Bristol Aquarium offers a different pace for a city day out. Take time at the displays, watch how the animals move and see which shapes and colours children can spot.

Our family idea: choose a favourite creature early in the visit and compare it with others as you explore. Ask children how each animal seems suited to its watery home.
